questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase your distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead at an intersection. Be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are heading the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Watch carefully because bicycles cross or ride beside traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells left-turning drivers that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Slow down and be ready to let the merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a construction flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright jackets and use paddles and flags to direct traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line means the action is prohibited. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic flows both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from the right will be merging into your lane. Be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.
